arguments.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rentals
FROM rental;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_payments,
  CAST(ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS DECIMAL(12, 2)) AS total_amount,
  CAST(ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS DECIMAL(12, 2)) AS average_payment_amount
FROM payment;

SELECT
  c.name AS category_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.rental_id) AS rental_count
FROM rental AS r
JOIN inventory AS i
  ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
JOIN film_category AS fc
  ON fc.film_id = i.film_id
JOIN category AS c
  ON c.category_id = fc.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
ORDER BY rental_count DESC, category_name ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rentals
FROM rental;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_payments,
  CAST(ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS DECIMAL(12, 2)) AS total_amount,
  CAST(ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS DECIMAL(12, 2)) AS average_payment_amount
FROM payment;

SELECT
  c.name AS category_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.rental_id) AS rental_count
FROM rental AS r
JOIN inventory AS i
  ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
JOIN film_category AS fc
  ON fc.film_id = i.film_id
JOIN category AS c
  ON c.category_id = fc.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
ORDER BY rental_count DESC, category_name ASC
LIMIT 3;

arguments.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rentals
FROM rental;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_payments,
  CAST(ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS DECIMAL(12, 2)) AS total_amount,
  CAST(ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS DECIMAL(12, 2)) AS average_payment_amount
FROM payment;

SELECT
  c.name AS category_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.rental_id) AS rental_count
FROM rental AS r
JOIN inventory AS i
  ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
JOIN film_category AS fc
  ON fc.film_id = i.film_id
JOIN category AS c
  ON c.category_id = fc.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
ORDER BY rental_count DESC, category_name ASC
LIMIT 3;
